limitations: This is a word-level isolated sign recognizer, not continuous ASL sentence translation.
Output similarity is not a calibrated probability.
Training results are project-reported; held-out top-k figures were not independently reproduced in this audit.

architecture.type: Bidirectional GRU temporal encoder with attention pooling

preprocessing.hand_normalization: Each hand is wrist-centered and scaled by its maximum absolute XYZ span.
preprocessing.missing_landmarks: Zero-filled; current app face mesh may not provide indices 468 and 473 used during training.

training_provenance.source: MuteMotion WLASL derived landmark dataset, Kaggle dataset abd0kamel/mutemotion-output
training_provenance.split: Official split field in WLASL_parsed_data.json; signer-disjointness not verified.
training_provenance.training_run: Private Kaggle kernel abdurrehmanzubair/sign-bridge-fyp-reproducible, version 1; 80 epochs, Tesla T4 x2.
training_provenance.initial_checkpoint: Private Kaggle dataset abdurrehmanzubair/signbridge-checkpoint-v2; license metadata unknown; weights-only checkpoint used to initialize fine-tuning.
training_provenance.license_note: Do not redistribute the fine-tuned model/checkpoint pending confirmation of rights for the source checkpoint and compliance with WLASL C-UDA.
training_provenance.artifact_evidence: artifacts/kaggle_run_2026-10-18 (gitignored local outputs; no raw feature cache or dataset copied).

runtime.platform_status: Android native camera/Holistic bridge; iOS camera-to-model integration is not implemented.
runtime.verification: Official held-out WLASL feature split, TFLite synthetic smoke test, and Pixel 6 Pro camera/Holistic path; a labeled user-signed real-world accuracy check remains outstanding.

evaluation.evaluation_source: Keras best checkpoint on official test partition; outputs in artifacts/kaggle_run_2026-10-18.

export_validation.device: Kaggle CPU XNNPACK for export benchmark; not phone end-to-end latency.
